editor_note: No misleading drift: the table, dates, qubit counts, the Osprey "quadruple the size of Eagle at 433 qubits" claim and the CRN/instance admonition logic (optional CRN → only that instance's backends/jobs; otherwise all instances) are all faithful, and the informal register holds (استخدم، إذا لم تحدد). Four editorial slips remain. (1) "cryostat" is rendered "التبريد التدريجي" ("gradual/staged cooling"), which names a process rather than the cryogenic vessel the flex cabling actually sits in — the standard rendering is المبرّد الكرايوجيني/الكرايوستات. (2) "instance" is rendered نسخة ("copy/version") throughout the CRN note where the established computing term is مثيل. (3) "deprecated" is rendered المتوقفة ("discontinued/stopped"), which overstates the status of `qiskit-ibm-provider` (it still returns jobs, per the same sentence); المُهمَلة is the accurate term. (4) In the Falcon bullet the second "valuable platform" is upgraded to بيئةً ممتازة ("excellent environment"), a mild strengthening of a deliberately flat English claim. Also note the mildly calqued heading term المتقاعدة for retired hardware, while the body and table use the more natural الإيقاف/تاريخ الإيقاف.

examples.why: "التبريد التدريجي" back-translates as "gradual cooling" — a process, not the cryostat vessel the cabling is routed inside; the reader loses the physical picture of the hardware.

editor_note: No misleading content: every instruction, caveat and troubleshooting case is faithfully carried over (the "deliberately creates an invalid environment" caution, the `qiskit-terra` conflict explanation, and the pipdeptree example all match the English). What a native editor would fix is a clean two-pass split at the Troubleshooting boundary (~line 356): "dependencies" is التبعيات everywhere before it and الاعتماديات everywhere after (lines 95/178/237 vs 435/439/554), and "packaging" is التعبئة in the intro (lines 21, 30) but تغليف in Troubleshooting (lines 358, 362). Separately, "pin `qiskit<1`" is rendered two ways — the good تفرض قيدًا على (lines 178, 330) and تُثبّت (lines 198, 268), which an Arabic reader parses first as "installs qiskit<1" rather than "declares a <1 requirement"; the same ثبّت stem is reused for "unpinned" at line 169 (إلغاء تثبيت الحد الأعلى). Minor extras: "actively maintained" becomes يُصانها فريق نشط (line 541), which invents a "team" not in the source and is ungrammatical, and "issue" is تذكرة at line 129 but left as issue at lines 408/587.

examples.suggested: وهو ما سيُسبّب على الأرجح مشاكل في البيئات…

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the dynamic-circuit caveat ("غير أن هذه الطريقة لا تُعيد نتائج دقيقة للدوائر الديناميكية") and the "but this is not required" qualifier ("لكن ذلك ليس إلزامياً") are both preserved, terminology is consistent (تصوير for visualize, ورقة أنماط for stylesheet, الدائرة المجدوَلة for scheduled circuit), and the informal register (يمكنك / استخدم / راجع) holds. Two editorial slips only: "idling time on qubits" is rendered "وقت التوقف" (reads as downtime/halt) where a hardware-timing editor would write "وقت الخمول" for an idle qubit; and "most of the ... appearance" is calqued twice as "معظم مظهر صورة الإخراج", which is ungrammatical-sounding in Arabic and would normally be "معظم جوانب مظهر صورة الإخراج". Neither would mislead a learner about the concept.

examples.source: This visualization could help you to quickly spot idling time on qubits, for example.
examples.suggested: يمكن أن يساعدك هذا التصوير مثلاً في اكتشاف أوقات خمول الـ Qubits بسرعة.
examples.translation: يمكن أن يساعدك هذا التصوير مثلاً في اكتشاف وقت التوقف على الـ Qubits بسرعة.
examples.why: "وقت التوقف" reads as downtime/halting; an idling qubit is one on which no operation is scheduled — the conventional rendering is خمول. Recognizable but imprecise.

examples.source: Most of the output image's appearance can be modified by a stylesheet ... you can control most of the appearance of the output image
examples.suggested: يمكن تعديل معظم جوانب مظهر صورة الإخراج عبر ورقة أنماط ... يمكنك التحكم في معظم جوانب مظهر صورة الإخراج

examples.why: "معظم" + a singular abstract noun (مظهر) is an English calque; Arabic needs a countable head such as جوانب/عناصر. A native technical writer would not leave it as is.

editor_note: No misleading drift: the four steps, the ISA-circuit definition ("لا تحتوي إلا على بوابات يفهمها العتاد المستهدف")، the Sampler→bitstrings / Estimator→expectation-values split, and the informal register (دوائرك، حاسوبك، تسعى) are all faithful and consistent. What a native technical editor would still change: "operators" is split within the file — "عوامل رياضية" (mathematical operators) in the bullet list and the H2 heading vs. the correct "العوامل الكمومية" one paragraph later; the physics terms in the post-processing paragraph are off — "parity" is rendered "التناظر" (= symmetry, not parity/التكافؤ) and "total spin" as "مجموع الدوران" (= sum of rotation) rather than السبين/اللف المغزلي; and "quasi-probability distributions" becomes the redundant "توزيعات الاحتمال شبه الاحتمالية" ("probability distributions that are quasi-probabilistic"). Two smaller slips: the bullet "**تحسين** الأداء للعتاد المستهدف" injects "الأداء" (performance), which the source does not say and which diverges from its own heading "التحسين للعتاد المستهدف"; and the hedge in "could provide many error mitigation options" is flattened to the flat indicative "ويوفر خيارات كثيرة لتخفيف الأخطاء".

examples.source: Map problem to quantum circuits and operators / a collection of circuits or quantum operators
examples.suggested: دوائر كمومية ومؤثرات (عوامل) كمومية — use one rendering throughout

examples.why: "operators" here are quantum operators; calling them "عوامل رياضية" (mathematical operators) in the bullet and heading but "العوامل الكمومية" in the next paragraph splits the same concept within the file.

examples.source: such as total spin, parity, or particle conservation
examples.suggested: كالسبين الكلي (اللف المغزلي الكلي)، أو التكافؤ، أو حفظ عدد الجسيمات
examples.translation: كمجموع الدوران، أو التناظر، أو حفظ الجسيمات
examples.why: "التناظر" is the standard word for symmetry, not parity (التكافؤ), and "مجموع الدوران" reads as "sum of rotation" rather than total spin; both are recognizable in context but are not the conventional Arabic physics terms.

examples.source: marginalizing quasi-probability distributions
examples.suggested: وتهميش التوزيعات شبه الاحتمالية
examples.translation: وهامشة توزيعات الاحتمال شبه الاحتمالية
examples.why: "توزيعات الاحتمال شبه الاحتمالية" is tautological ("probability distributions that are quasi-probabilistic"), and "هامشة" is a non-standard coinage for marginalizing; a native writer would use تهميش + التوزيعات شبه الاحتمالية.

examples.source: **Optimize** for target hardware
examples.suggested: **تحسين** الدوائر للعتاد المستهدف (or plain: **التحسين** للعتاد المستهدف, matching the heading)
examples.translation: **تحسين** الأداء للعتاد المستهدف
examples.why: "الأداء" (performance) is added; the step optimizes the circuits for the hardware, not performance in the abstract, and the bullet no longer matches its own section heading "التحسين للعتاد المستهدف".

examples.suggested: …ويمكن أن يوفر خيارات كثيرة لتخفيف الأخطاء
examples.translation: تحديد المتغيرات القابلة للقياس يستخدم Estimator ويوفر خيارات كثيرة لتخفيف الأخطاء

editor_note: The prose is faithful and generally natural — it even repairs the broken English sentence at source line 47 ("provides a … objects should be used") into clean Arabic ("يوفر Qiskit SDK الكائنات … التي ينبغي استخدامها"), and core terms (QPU→وحدة معالجة الكم، basis gates→بوابات الأساس، workloads→أعباء العمل الكمومية) are correct and consistent. Three things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The frontmatter `title` is "إنشاء مزوّد خدمة" ("Create a provider") while the EN frontmatter title and the translated H1 are both "Integrate external quantum resources with Qiskit" / "دمج موارد الحوسبة الكمومية الخارجية مع Qiskit" — the sidebar/browser title therefore disagrees with the page's own heading. (2) "لكي يتمكن المستخدمون من transpile وتنفيذ كائنات `QuantumCircuit`" splices the bare English verb into an Arabic منْ-construction that requires a masdar; no Arabic technical writer would phrase it that way. (3) The EN comparative "a simpler approach would be" is strengthened to the superlative "أبسط نهج هو" ("the simplest approach is"), and "instance" is rendered "نسخة" (copy) rather than "مثيل". None of these would give a learner a false belief.

examples.source: title: Integrate external quantum resources with Qiskit
examples.suggested: title: دمج موارد الحوسبة الكمومية الخارجية مع Qiskit
examples.translation: title: إنشاء مزوّد خدمة
examples.why: The frontmatter title translates a different (older) headline than the source, so the sidebar/tab label contradicts the page's own translated H1 on line 6.

examples.source: In order for users to transpile and execute `QuantumCircuit` objects using external resources
examples.suggested: لكي يتمكن المستخدمون من إجراء عملية transpile لكائنات `QuantumCircuit` وتنفيذها باستخدام موارد خارجية
examples.translation: لكي يتمكن المستخدمون من transpile وتنفيذ كائنات `QuantumCircuit` باستخدام موارد خارجية
examples.why: ‘من’ governs a masdar; inserting the bare English infinitive ‘transpile’ into the coordination with ‘وتنفيذ’ is ungrammatical-sounding and reads as raw splice rather than native technical Arabic.

examples.source: This object should, at minimum, contain a `Target`, but a simpler approach would be to return a `BackendV2` instance.
examples.suggested: … غير أن هناك نهجاً أبسط، وهو إعادة مثيل من `BackendV2`.
examples.translation: يجب أن يحتوي هذا الكائن، كحدٍّ أدنى، على `Target`، غير أن أبسط نهج هو إعادة نسخة من `BackendV2`.
examples.why: The English comparative/conditional ‘a simpler approach would be’ is hardened into a superlative assertion ‘the simplest approach is’, and ‘instance’ becomes ‘نسخة’ (copy) instead of the conventional ‘مثيل’.

editor_note: Prose is faithful, fluent and consistently informal-singular (أعدّ مدخلاتك، مرِّر مدخلاتك، تأكد من أنك اتّبعت)، with stable terminology (job→مهمة، workload→حمل عمل، status→حالة، logs→السجلات، backend/optimization_level kept as code). One verb drift: the English "You can also **set** more detailed job statuses in [Manage Qiskit Serverless compute and data resources]" becomes "يمكنك أيضاً **الاطلاع على** حالات أكثر تفصيلاً للمهام في…" — i.e. a capability the learner can configure is turned into something they merely read about, so the Arabic reader never learns that custom, finer-grained statuses can be defined. Everything else checks out paragraph-for-paragraph, including the quantity in "لإنشاء 30 دائرة عشوائية" which faithfully mirrors the (upstream-inconsistent) English "create 30 random circuits", the QUEUED/INITIALIZING/RUNNING/DONE list, and the caveat that the IBM Quantum workloads table reflects only Qiskit Runtime workloads.

examples.source: You can also set more detailed job statuses in [Manage Qiskit Serverless compute and data resources].
examples.suggested: يمكنك أيضاً تعيين حالات أكثر تفصيلاً للمهام في [إدارة موارد الحوسبة والبيانات في Qiskit Serverless].
examples.translation: يمكنك أيضاً الاطلاع على حالات أكثر تفصيلاً للمهام في [إدارة موارد الحوسبة والبيانات في Qiskit Serverless].
examples.why: "set" (an action the user performs in their program) is rendered as "الاطلاع على" (view/read about), converting a configurable capability into passive reading; the learner loses the fact that finer-grained job statuses can be defined.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the quantitative claims (60 bits ≈ 300 transmisiones vs. 1 bit → 2400; "los primeros dos `if_test` ... una transmisión", "cuatro bits transmitidos"; el límite de 32 bits del operando; "no contiene el valor de `creg`") all survive intact, and the informal tú register holds ("puedes", "ten en cuenta", "consulta"). What a native technical editor would still change is stylistic/terminological: (1) "job" is rendered inconsistently — "en un trabajo (no en un circuit)" and "el trabajo puede tener 2400 transmisiones" in the Limitaciones section, but "resultado del job" / "después de que el job termine" in the `Store` note, within the same page; (2) "circuit schedule visualization" → "visualización del horario del circuit" is a bad calque — "horario" means a timetable of clock hours, not circuit timing/scheduling ("programación temporal"/"cronograma"); (3) the "as IBM Quantum releases the new version" clause is garbled into "es un área de mejora en la que IBM Quantum® lanza la nueva versión", which drops "focus" and turns a temporal "as" into a nonsensical relative clause; (4) English word order leaks in "el `temp` BitArray devuelto" (should be "el BitArray `temp`") and "el atributo primitivo `BitArray`" (EN means an attribute *of the primitive result*, not an attribute that is "primitivo"); (5) the repeated passive "no está admitido / no están admitidas / no está admitido" for "is not supported" is stiff where a native writer says "no se admite(n)" or "no es compatible". None of these would lead a learner to a false belief.

examples.source: ...the number of broadcasted bits in a job (not a circuit). ... the job can have 2400 broadcasts. // ...not copied or returned in the job result ... after the job finishes
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "job" for the whole page — either "job" (kept, as in the Store note) or "trabajo" — and use it in both sections.
examples.translation: ...el número de bits transmitidos en un trabajo (no en un circuit). ... el trabajo puede tener 2400 transmisiones. // ...no se copia ni se devuelve en el resultado del job ... después de que el job termine
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: the same concept appears as "trabajo" in the Qiskit Runtime limitations list and as "job" in the `Store` note, so a reader cannot tell they refer to the same submitted execution.

examples.source: Use [circuit schedule visualization](/guides/qiskit-runtime-circuit-timing) to debug and optimize your dynamic circuits.
examples.suggested: Usa la [visualización de la programación temporal del circuit](...) para depurar y optimizar tus circuits dinámicos.
examples.translation: Usa la [visualización del horario del circuit](/guides/qiskit-runtime-circuit-timing) para depurar y optimizar tus circuits dinámicos.
examples.why: "Horario" in Spanish is a timetable of clock hours (school/train schedule); the circuit-timing sense requires "programación temporal" or "cronograma". A pure calque no Spanish-speaking quantum engineer would write.

examples.source: Therefore, reducing the length of mid-circuit measurement is a focus area of improvement as IBM Quantum® releases the new version of dynamic circuits.
examples.suggested: Por lo tanto, reducir la duración de las mediciones de medio circuit es un área prioritaria de mejora, ahora que IBM Quantum® lanza la [nueva versión] de los circuits dinámicos.
examples.translation: Por lo tanto, reducir la longitud de las mediciones de medio circuit es un área de mejora en la que IBM Quantum® lanza la [nueva versión] de los circuits dinámicos.
examples.why: The temporal/causal "as" is turned into the relative clause "en la que ... lanza", which does not parse (one does not "release a version inside an improvement area"), and "focus" is dropped so the emphasis on this being a priority is lost.

examples.source: ...the `temp` BitArray returned in the job result **does not** contain the value of `creg`. // You can use the [`BitArray`] primitive attribute to compute the expectation values...
examples.suggested: ...el BitArray `temp` devuelto en el resultado del job... // Puedes usar el atributo [`BitArray`] del primitivo para calcular los valores de expectación...
examples.translation: ...el `temp` BitArray devuelto en el resultado del job **no contiene** el valor de `creg`. // Puedes usar el atributo primitivo [`BitArray`] para calcular los valores de expectación...
examples.why: English noun-adjective order is carried over literally: Spanish puts the identifier after the type ("el BitArray `temp`"), and "primitive attribute" means "attribute of the primitive", not an attribute that is "primitivo".

examples.source: Having `reset` or measurements inside conditionals is not supported. Arithmetic operations are not supported. ... The `for`, `while`, and `switch` instructions are not supported.
examples.suggested: No se admite el uso de `reset` ni de mediciones dentro de condicionales. No se admiten operaciones aritméticas. ... No se admiten las instrucciones `for`, `while` ni `switch`.
examples.translation: Tener `reset` o mediciones dentro de condicionales no está admitido. Las operaciones aritméticas no están admitidas. ... Las instrucciones `for`, `while` y `switch` no están admitidas.
examples.why: The repeated "estar + admitido" passive is a stiff calque of English "is not supported"; Spanish technical writing uses the impersonal "no se admite" or "no es compatible con".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped versions/quantities, no hallucinated claims; the tricky passages (constraints file with `qiskit-terra>=1.0`, the `pipdeptree --reverse` example, the "El ejemplo se generó antes del lanzamiento de Qiskit v1.0" note) all land correctly, and informal "tú" holds everywhere. What a native editor would change: the Troubleshooting section is named two ways in the same file — the intro bullet links to "Solución de problemas" (l.28, l.129) but the actual heading reads "Resolución de problemas" (l.358); "in-place" is calqued and inconsistent ("en el mismo lugar" l.19/l.36 vs "en el lugar" l.201, where "in situ" is the idiomatic term); and "branch-protecting on CI success" becomes the barely parseable "proteger ramas en CI con éxito contra la rama `main`" (l.175-176). Two smaller stiffness slips: "que aparentar que todo funciona correctamente" (l.362) shifts the subject onto the reader where the English says things merely appear to work, and "El dependiente" (l.538, l.543) is a bare calque of "the dependent" where "el paquete dependiente" is needed.

examples.source: review the [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) section … ## Troubleshooting
examples.suggested: Use one name in both places, e.g. "Solución de problemas" for the link text and the heading
examples.translation: revisa la sección [Solución de problemas](#troubleshooting) … ## Resolución de problemas
examples.why: The cross-reference label and the section heading differ, so the reader following the link does not find the section name they were told to look for.

examples.source: We do not recommend initially branch-protecting on CI success against the Qiskit `main` branch … we *do* recommend branch-protecting on success against the latest release candidate
examples.suggested: No recomendamos, al principio, exigir que el CI contra la rama `main` de Qiskit pase como comprobación obligatoria para fusionar … sí recomendamos exigirlo contra el último candidato a lanzamiento
examples.translation: No recomendamos proteger ramas en CI con éxito contra la rama `main` de Qiskit inicialmente … *sí* recomendamos proteger ramas con éxito contra el último candidato a lanzamiento
examples.why: "proteger ramas … con éxito contra" is a word-for-word calque of "branch-protecting on success against" that a Spanish-speaking engineer would not write; the actual mechanism (required CI check on a protected branch) is left for the reader to reconstruct.

examples.source: upgrade an existing Python virtual environment to Qiskit v1.0 in-place … To upgrade an environment in situ
examples.suggested: actualizar in situ un entorno virtual de Python existente … Para actualizar un entorno in situ

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout; the load-bearing trade-off sentence is rendered correctly ("al reducir el `rep_delay`, el tiempo total de ejecución en la QPU disminuye, a costa de aumentar la tasa de error en la preparación de estados"), the double no-guarantee caveat about PUB ordering and single-batch execution is fully preserved, and terminology is consistent (shot/backend/reset kept in English, "trabajo de primitivas", "tiempo de retraso de repetición") with informal tú held all the way (Ejecuta, envías, Verifica siempre, Prueba, Revisa).

Semantically faithful throughout — the depolarizing-channel explanation keeps the correct polarity ("con probabilidad $p$, el estado se reemplaza… y el estado se preserva con probabilidad $1 - p$"), the 2% CX error, the $(1-p)^m$ reasoning, the 65% figure and the "estimación conservadora… no toma en cuenta el estado inicial" caveat all match the English exactly, and register is consistently informal tú (Aprende, obtendrías, crea, Consulta, Revisa). Core terms are correct and internally consistent (qubit, compuerta CX, valor de expectación, observable, modelo de ruido, primitiva Estimator/Sampler). The one real terminology slip is "estado completamente mezclado" for "completely mixed state": the established Spanish QM term is "estado (completamente/máximamente) mixto" — the pure/mixed contrast is "puro/mixto", and "mezclado" reads as shuffled rather than as a density-matrix mixture. Two mild calques remain: "muestrear del circuito ruidoso" (English "sample from"; natural Spanish is "tomar muestras del circuito ruidoso") and "una discusión de estas técnicas está fuera del alcance de este artículo" (a native writer would write "su discusión queda fuera del alcance de este artículo"). editor_note: No hay deriva semántica ni alucinaciones: la física (Burgers no viscosa, rejilla t/x, mapeo stress→tensión / strain→deformación en $\epsilon_0$, $\sigma_0$, $u$, $\sigma$, bulk modulus→módulo volumétrico), los números (30 puntos, paso 0.2375, paso 0.04, tabla 50/18 qubits, 66/123 min) y las condicionales ("aunque la opción predeterminada proporciona buenos resultados, puedes configurarla con mayor detalle") coinciden con el inglés. Lo que sí cambiaría un editor técnico nativo: "surface stress" se rinde como "tensión superficial", que en español es el término consagrado para *surface tension* (propiedad de fluidos) y no para el esfuerzo superficial de una barra en tracción — "esfuerzo superficial" evitaría el falso amigo, aunque el contexto ("la cantidad de trabajo necesaria para estirar la barra") lo mantiene identificable. Además hay un desliz de concordancia en la tabla ("Ensayo de tracción hipoelástica 1D" → debería ser "hipoelástico", que concuerda con *ensayo*) y una pasiva calcada con regionalismo, "una barra fija en el espacio es jalada por su otro extremo", que choca con el registro peninsular del resto del archivo ("Rellena el formulario"). "múltiples físicas" por *multi-physics* es literal; lo habitual es "multifísica".

editor_note: The Overview inverts the product's central claim: "The entire workflow is noise-aware" becomes "L'ensemble du flux de travail est sensible au bruit", which in French technical usage means the workflow is *susceptible to* noise — a defect — instead of noise-aware / taking noise into account ("tient compte du bruit", "prend en compte le bruit"). A learner reads the Solver's headline strength as a weakness. Secondary drift in the Benchmarks section: "rough thresholds where you can expect extremely consistent solution accuracy" gains an unsourced direction, "des seuils approximatifs **en dessous desquels** tu peux t'attendre...", asserting something the English does not say. Smaller editorial slips: the discourse marker "Now every edge..." is rendered temporally as "Désormais, chaque arête...", the English "First... Second..." enumeration in the MVC derivation loses its "Second" ("D'abord..." then a bare "L'objectif est de minimiser..."), and the Package-versions accordion body plus the admonition title "Does this function support all IBM backends?" are left untranslated. Register is otherwise consistently informal "tu" and the optimization vocabulary (coupe maximale/Max-Cut, couverture minimale de sommets, termes de pénalité, arêtes/sommets, fonction objectif) is correct and consistent.

examples.translation: Você também pode definir a variável de ambiente `AI_TRANSPILER_MAX_THREADS` com o número desejado de threads máximo, e todos os passes de síntese instanciados após isso usarão esse valor.
examples.why: "de threads máximo" dangles — "máximo" is meant to qualify "número", not "threads", so the phrase reads as a mirrored clunk from the English rather than something a Portuguese-speaking engineer would write. Meaning is still clear, so this is cosmetic only.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads: every paragraph tracks the English faithfully — the "sequência de etapas chamadas passes de transpilação" explanation, the "nível de abstração acima do gerenciador de passagem normal" contrast, the "Não há limite para o número de estágios" claim and the pre_layout / generate_embed_passmanager passages all carry the same meaning, emphasis and caveats as the source, and the informal "você" register is consistent. The one editorial complaint is terminology: the English word "pass" is rendered two different ways in the same file — as "passe" when it is a transpiler pass ("passes de transpilação") but as "passagem" inside the compound "gerenciador de passagem" (PassManager), which reads as "manager of passage/transit" rather than "manager of passes"; "gerenciador de passes" (or keeping "pass manager") would be the conventional rendering and would match the rest of the file. Secondarily, "transpiler pass" itself splits between "passe de transpilação" in the body and "passe de transpilador" in the Next-steps list, and the section headings mix moods ("Gerar…", "Crie seu próprio…", "Criar…"). All of this is cosmetic — the concepts stay identifiable throughout.

examples.source: A pass manager is an object that stores a list of transpiler passes

examples.translation: Um gerenciador de passagem é um objeto que armazena uma lista de passes de transpilação
examples.why: The same English noun "pass" is translated as "passe" for the list elements but as "passagem" (passage/transit) in the compound name of the object that manages them; "gerenciador de passes" is both the conventional rendering and internally consistent with the rest of the file.

examples.source: Write your own transpiler pass / transpilation passes
examples.suggested: Use one form throughout, e.g. "passe de transpilação" in both places
examples.translation: passes de transpilação (body) vs "Escrever um passe de transpilador personalizado" (Próximas etapas)
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency for the same term; harmless for comprehension but a native technical editor would unify it, especially since the two forms sit in the same document and refer to the identical concept.

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout; the kernel-restart caveat ("Reiniciar o kernel Python significa que você perderá todos os resultados armazenados na memória") and "use a biblioteca JSON integrada do Python com codificadores do Qiskit Runtime" both match the English exactly, with job/kernel/sessão/Backend kept consistently and informal "você" held.

No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantity, condition and caveat survives intact — the shots admonition ("Ang mga shot ay **hindi** nahahati sa mga configuration ... kabuuang 10,240 shots"), the broadcast tables, and the twirling note ("karaniwang walang kalamangan kumpara sa pagpapatakbo ng base circuit nang walang randomization") all match the English exactly, and the register is correctly casual. The defects are word-choice/terminology slips a native technical editor would fix. Most notable: "measurements" is rendered "mga sukat" ("sizes/dimensions") in the same document that uses "sukat-1 na dimensyon" for numpy *size*, so "Bitstring na datos mula sa mga sukat" collides with the shape vocabulary — "pagsukat" is the domain term. Also "correspond" is rendered "tumutugon" (= respond) at line ~175 where the same relation is correctly "tumutugma" at line ~169, "holding others fixed" becomes "pinapanatiling nakatali" (= tied), and "the last row of the following table" becomes "huling hanay", which in Tagalog usually reads as column ("hilera" is the row).

examples.source: The most common output is bitstring data from measurements ... | Classical register data | (num_shots, creg_size) | Bitstring data from measurements |
examples.suggested: ... bitstring na datos mula sa mga pagsukat ...
examples.translation: Ang pinakakaraniwang output ay bitstring na datos mula sa mga sukat ... | Bitstring na datos mula sa mga sukat |
examples.why: "sukat" means size/dimension and the file already uses it that way ("sukat-1 na dimensyon" for size-1 dimensions), so "mula sa mga sukat" collides with the shape vocabulary. The quantum-measurement sense is "pagsukat".

examples.source: You can use the `shape` parameter to augment the extrinsic shape for the item, effectively adding axes that correspond specifically to randomizing the same configuration many times.
examples.suggested: ... mga axis na partikular na tumutugma sa pag-randomize ...
examples.translation: ... na epektibong nagdadagdag ng mga axis na partikular na tumutugon sa pag-randomize ng parehong configuration nang maraming beses.
examples.why: "tumutugon" = respond, not correspond; the very same relation is correctly rendered "tumutugma" six lines earlier ("bawat elemento ng extrinsic na hugis ay tumutugma sa isang independyenteng pagpapatakbo"), so the file is also inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: Use code like the following to sweep one parameter while holding others fixed:
examples.suggested: ... habang pinapanatiling nakapirmi/nakatakda ang iba:
examples.translation: ... para mag-sweep ng isang parameter habang pinapanatiling nakatali ang iba:
examples.why: "nakatali" literally means tied/bound; a Tagalog technical writer describing a held-constant parameter would write "nakapirmi" or "nakatakda". Understandable but not idiomatic.

examples.source: ... as is illustrated in the last row of the following table.
examples.suggested: ... sa huling hilera ng sumusunod na talahanayan.
examples.translation: ... tulad ng ipinapakita sa huling hanay ng sumusunod na talahanayan.
examples.why: "hanay" is commonly read as column in Tagalog; the referent is the last ROW ((4,3)/(2,1,3)). "hilera" removes the ambiguity in a passage whose whole point is which axis expands.

editor_note: No semantic drift anywhere: the removal caveat ("hindi na nila makikita ang kanilang mga workload... Ang ibang mga gumagamit sa parehong instance ay makakaakses pa rin") preserves both halves of the English exactly, and the "Bago ka magsimula" tip keeps the create-instances-first ordering and the auto-generated access group. Two surface slips a native technical editor would fix: (1) "piliin ang mga access group na dapat kasapi ang gumagamit" is a malformed relative clause — the linker is missing, natural Filipino would be "kung saan dapat mapabilang ang gumagamit" or "na dapat kabilangan ng gumagamit"; (2) "ang mga in-imbitahang gumagamit" uses the English-root hyphen prefix on an already-nativized verb — standard orthography is "inimbitahan" (the file itself writes "mag-imbita"/"pag-iimbita" without it). Register is correctly casual throughout (mo/iyong, no po/opo) and "gumagamit" for user is consistent across all six occurrences.

examples.translation: piliin ang mga access group na dapat kasapi ang gumagamit

examples.translation: opsyonal na italaga ang mga in-imbitahang gumagamit sa mga access group

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: all quantities (1024/1000 shots, 900 randomizations, 10 sets of parameter values, three unique instructions, expected value 1.0), conditions and caveats match the English, and the informal register holds throughout. The defects are lexical. "Execute" is rendered three ways in the same file — "Isabuhay" (steps list and both "Isabuhay ang mga circuit" headings), "Isakatuparan" (the two PEC bullets) and "Patakbuhin" (the Executor-job heading); "Isabuhay" literally means "to live out / put into practice" and is the wrong verb for running a circuit, though context keeps it recognizable. "measurements" is rendered as the bare noun "sukat" ("i-grupo ang mga gate at sukat"), which reads as "sizes" rather than "mga pagsukat"; "pagdefinisyon" (for "In defining uniqueness") is not a Tagalog word — "sa pagtukoy" is; and the mathematical idiom "equal, up to single-qubit gates" is calqued as "pantay, hanggang sa single-qubit na gate", where "hanggang sa" reads as a range limit instead of "modulo".

examples.source: Execute: Add a circuit item and a samplex item ... / Execute the circuits / Execute the circuit with twirling. / Run the Executor job
examples.suggested: Use one verb throughout, e.g. "Patakbuhin" (or "Isagawa"): "Patakbuhin ang mga circuit", "Patakbuhin ang circuit gamit ang twirling".
examples.translation: Isabuhay: Magdagdag ng circuit item ... / Isabuhay ang mga circuit / Isakatuparan ang circuit gamit ang twirling. / Patakbuhin ang Executor job
examples.why: "Isabuhay" means "to live out / embody" and is never used for running code; combined with "Isakatuparan" and "Patakbuhin" the same English verb appears under three different Tagalog headings in one page. Recognizable in context, so MINOR.

examples.source: Group gates and measurements into annotated boxes ... group two-qubit gates and measurements into boxes
examples.suggested: I-grupo ang mga gate at mga pagsukat (measurement) sa mga annotated box
examples.translation: I-grupo ang mga gate at sukat sa mga annotated box ... i-grupo ang mga two-qubit gate at sukat sa mga box
examples.why: As a bare noun "sukat" reads as "size/dimension"; the operation meant here is a measurement, which is "pagsukat" (or the kept English "measurement", as the file already does in "measurement box" and "measurement twirling").

examples.source: In defining uniqueness, two box instructions are equal if both of the following are true:
examples.suggested: Sa pagtukoy kung ano ang natatangi, magkapantay ang dalawang box instruction kung pareho ang mga sumusunod ay totoo:
examples.translation: Sa pagdefinisyon ng uniqueness, ang dalawang tagubilin ng box ay pantay kung ang parehong mga sumusunod ay totoo:
examples.why: "pagdefinisyon" is not a Tagalog word (a Spanish/English stem forced into a pag- nominalization), and "uniqueness" is left raw beside it; a native technical writer would write "pagtukoy" / "pagbibigay-kahulugan".

examples.source: Their content is equal, up to single-qubit gates. ... This leads to three unique instructions, namely the odd and even gate boxes
examples.suggested: ... pantay maliban sa mga single-qubit gate. ... tatlong natatanging instruction, samakatuwid ang odd at even na gate box ...
examples.translation: Ang kanilang nilalaman ay pantay, hanggang sa single-qubit na gate. ... Ito ay humahantong sa tatlong natatanging tagubilin, katulad ng odd at even na gate box
examples.why: "hanggang sa" is a literal calque of the mathematical idiom "up to" and reads as a range limit rather than "modulo"; "katulad ng" renders "namely" as "similar to", weakening an exact enumeration into an approximation.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout: the overhead/balance caveat in the intro ("Ang mga teknik na ito ay karaniwang nagdudulot ng overhead sa pre-processing... mahalaga na makamit ang balanse"), the negation in the Admonition ("Hindi lahat ng opsyon ay gumagana nang magkasama sa lahat ng uri ng circuit"), and the two listed techniques all match the English exactly, with no dropped caveats or added claims. The one thing a native technical editor would change is the last Next-steps bullet: "Magpasya kung anong execution mode ang pagpapatakbuhin ng iyong job" uses a malformed verb ("pagpapatakbuhin" conflates the gerund "pagpapatakbo" with the future "patatakbuhin"), so the clause is ungrammatical — natural phrasing would be "kung anong execution mode ang gagamitin mo para patakbuhin ang iyong job". It is stiff, not misleading; the reader still gets the intended instruction. Register is consistently informal (no po/opo), and terminology (noise management, error mitigation/suppression, circuit, job, Sampler) is kept in English consistently, matching the file's own convention.

examples.source: Decide what [execution mode](execution-modes) to run your job in.
examples.suggested: Magpasya kung anong [execution mode](execution-modes) ang gagamitin mo para patakbuhin ang iyong job.
examples.translation: Magpasya kung anong [execution mode](execution-modes) ang pagpapatakbuhin ng iyong job.
examples.why: "pagpapatakbuhin" is not a valid verb form (it mixes the gerund pagpapatakbo with the contemplated-aspect patatakbuhin), leaving the clause ungrammatical; the meaning still comes through, so this is stiffness rather than drift.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the six-month/one-year support windows, "hanggang dalawang release series," the `qiskit<2` capping example, the QPY backwards-but-not-forward-compatible pair, and the 0.25.2.1 post-release story all land correctly, and the informal register holds with no po/opo. The one rendering worth fixing is the opening policy sentence: "Breaking API changes" becomes "Ang mga pagbabagong nakaka-apekto sa API" ("changes that affect the API"), which over-broadens the claim and sits awkwardly against the very next sentence saying minor versions add new features; elsewhere the file correctly keeps "breaking" ("breaking release", "breaking na pagbabago sa API"), so it is also an internal inconsistency. Two spots read as stiff calqued English ("Kaunti bago ang isang bagong major na bersyon"; "Ang isang tentative na iskedyul ng release ay kasama sa ibaba"), and there are two verb-form slips ("magtatataas", "tinatataas").

examples.source: Breaking API changes are reserved for major version releases.
examples.suggested: Ang mga breaking na pagbabago sa API (mga pagbabagong sumisira sa compatibility) ay nakalaan para sa mga major na release ng bersyon.
examples.translation: Ang mga pagbabagong nakaka-apekto sa API ay nakalaan para sa mga major na release ng bersyon.
examples.why: "nakaka-apekto sa API" = "affecting the API", which is broader than "breaking" and contradicts the next sentence stating that minor versions introduce new features. It also splits from the file's own later renderings "breaking release" and "breaking na pagbabago sa API".

examples.source: Shortly before a new major version, a final minor version will be published.
examples.suggested: Bago pa lamang ilabas ang bagong major na bersyon, ilalathala ang isang panghuling minor na bersyon.
examples.translation: Kaunti bago ang isang bagong major na bersyon, isang panghuling minor na bersyon ang ilalathala.
examples.why: "Kaunti bago" is not idiomatic Tagalog for "shortly before"; a native technical writer would write "Ilang sandali bago" or "Bago pa lamang ilabas".

examples.source: A tentative release schedule is included below:
examples.suggested: Narito sa ibaba ang isang tentative na iskedyul ng release:
examples.translation: Ang isang tentative na iskedyul ng release ay kasama sa ibaba:
examples.why: Word-for-word English passive with a fronted "Ang isang..." subject; Tagalog prose in docs normally uses the existential/presentative "Narito ang...".

examples.source: Only minor or major version releases will raise minimum requirements ... the minimum version of a dependency is only increased when ...
examples.suggested: ... lamang ang magtataas ng mga minimum na kinakailangan ... ang minimum na bersyon ng isang dependency ay itinataas lamang kapag ...
examples.translation: ... lamang ang magtatataas ng mga minimum na kinakailangan ... ang minimum na bersyon ng isang dependency ay tinatataas lamang kapag ...
examples.why: "magtatataas" carries an extra reduplicated syllable (correct form: magtataas), and "tinatataas" should be "itinataas" for the object-focus passive.

editor_note: The core explanatory sentence in "Ano ang isang (staged) pass manager?" reverses actor and patient: "Pinoproseso ng circuit ang bawat transpiler pass nang sunud-sunod" says *the circuit processes each transpiler pass*, the exact opposite of the English "The circuit is processed by each transpiler pass in sequence." In Tagalog patient-focus (pinoproseso ... ang X), the ng-marked "circuit" is unambiguously the agent, so a learner is taught the transpilation data flow backwards in the one sentence that defines it; the fix is "Pinoproseso ng bawat transpiler pass ang circuit nang sunud-sunod". Separately, the whole `<Admonition type="note">` about the `FakeSherbrooke` mock backend ("...you can try it on any Qiskit-compatible real or fake backend. Your results might be different.") is left entirely in English while every other prose block is translated — a caveat the Tagalog reader effectively loses. Everything else (staged pass manager, yugto for "stage", "Walang limitasyon sa bilang ng mga yugto", the pre_layout/stage-generator passage) is faithful, natural and consistent.

examples.source: The circuit is processed by each transpiler pass in sequence, with the output of one pass becoming the input to the next.
examples.suggested: Pinoproseso ng bawat transpiler pass ang circuit nang sunud-sunod, kung saan ang output ng isang pass ang nagiging input sa susunod.
examples.translation: Pinoproseso ng circuit ang bawat transpiler pass nang sunud-sunod, kung saan ang output ng isang pass ang nagiging input sa susunod.
examples.why: Agent/patient inversion: as written, the circuit is the one doing the processing and the passes are what get processed — the reverse of the English, teaching the transpilation pipeline direction backwards.

examples.source: The `FakeSherbrooke` mock backend from `qiskit_ibm_runtime` is used in these examples, but you can try it on any Qiskit-compatible real or fake backend. Your results might be different.
examples.suggested: Ang `FakeSherbrooke` mock backend mula sa `qiskit_ibm_runtime` ang ginagamit sa mga halimbawang ito, pero maaari mo itong subukan sa anumang real o fake backend na compatible sa Qiskit. Maaaring iba ang iyong mga resulta.
examples.translation: (left verbatim in English inside <Admonition type="note">)
examples.why: An entire prose admonition — including the caveat that results may differ — is untranslated while all surrounding prose is in Tagalog.

editor_note: No misleading drift: numbers (112/84/56 qubits, population_size 120 vs 40, 0.8 * n_qubits minimum, "від найменшого до найбільшого"), conditions, and caveats all track the English, and the informal "ти" register holds throughout ("Пройди автентифікацію", "Визнач задачу", "ти можеш"). What a native editor would still change is terminology and phrasing: "Variational Quantum Eigensolver" is rendered as "Варіаційного Квантового Власного Розкладача" — an English-style title-cased calque, where the field says "варіаційний квантовий розв'язувач задачі на власні значення" (or just keeps VQE); "Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization" becomes "Квадратичної Незв'язаної Бінарної Оптимізації", where "незв'язаної" reads as "uncoupled/unlinked" rather than "без обмежень", and the same file correctly uses "обмеження" for constraints elsewhere. "quantum hardware" is twice rendered as "квантовому залізі" (slang "залізо"), which no Ukrainian technical writer would use in reference docs, and "noise-aware post-processing" becomes "шумозахисну постобробку" ("noise-shielding") rather than "з урахуванням шуму". Also a within-file split: "objective costs" is "цільова вартість" in the benchmarks but "значень цільових функцій" in the distribution paragraph.

examples.source: uses the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithm to solve a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem
examples.suggested: використовує алгоритм варіаційного квантового розв'язувача задачі на власні значення (VQE) для розв'язання задачі квадратичної бінарної оптимізації без обмежень (QUBO)
examples.translation: використовує алгоритм Варіаційного Квантового Власного Розкладача (VQE) для розв'язання задачі Квадратичної Незв'язаної Бінарної Оптимізації (QUBO)
examples.why: "Власний Розкладач" is a calque ("eigen-decomposer") with English title case; "Незв'язаної" reads as "uncoupled" rather than "unconstrained" — the same file uses "обмеження" correctly for constraints, so the expansion is both imperfect and inconsistent. Recognizable thanks to the VQE/QUBO acronyms, hence minor.

examples.source: the input problem and the VQE algorithm are adapted to be run in the quantum hardware. The VQE algorithm is then run on the quantum hardware
examples.suggested: ...адаптуються для виконання на квантовому обладнанні. Після цього алгоритм VQE виконується на квантовому обладнанні

examples.why: "залізо" is colloquial IT slang for hardware; in reference documentation a Ukrainian technical writer would write "обладнання" / "апаратне забезпечення".

examples.source: a noise-aware (SQD-based) post-processing to maximize the quality of the output
examples.suggested: постобробку з урахуванням шуму (на основі SQD) для максимізації якості вихідних даних
examples.translation: шумозахисну постобробку на основі (SQD) для максимізації якості вихідних даних
examples.why: "шумозахисна" says "noise-shielding/protective"; "noise-aware" means the post-processing takes noise into account. Close enough not to mislead, but the nuance is shifted, and the parenthesis placement "на основі (SQD)" is awkward.

examples.source: the probability distributions of the objective costs ... The objective cost, which measures optimization efficiency
examples.suggested: розподіли ймовірностей значень цільової вартості ... (consistent with the benchmark table's "Цільова вартість")
examples.translation: розподіли ймовірностей значень цільових функцій ... Цільова вартість, яка вимірює ефективність оптимізації
examples.why: "objective cost" is rendered as "цільова вартість" in section 6/benchmarks but as "значення цільових функцій" in the distribution paragraph — same quantity, two names, within a few lines.

examples.source: Results show that the quantum optimizer, with problem-specific ansatzes, effectively identifies efficient investment strategies across various portfolio types.
examples.suggested: ...із ансатцами, підібраними під конкретну задачу, дієво знаходить ефективні інвестиційні стратегії...
examples.translation: Результати показують, що квантовий оптимізатор із задачно-специфічними ансатцами ефективно визначає ефективні інвестиційні стратегії для різних типів портфелів.
examples.why: "задачно-специфічними" is a raw calque of "problem-specific", and "ефективно ... ефективні" repeats the same root in one clause — stiff, not how a native technical writer would phrase it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat: the Pauli-$Z$ basis paragraph, the `measure_all` default-`ClassicalRegister` note and the "(доступно лише при використанні Qiskit Runtime)" caveat all match the English exactly, and informal "ти" holds consistently (Дізнайся / Використовуй). Two editorial nits only. First, "виміряти його _на_ класичний біт" calques English "onto"; Ukrainian technical usage takes the accusative-into form ("виміряти його **в** класичний біт"), which the same file already uses correctly later ("виміряти всі кубіти **у** відповідні класичні біти"). Second, in the `measure_active` paragraph "idle" is rendered two ways in adjacent sentences — the stiff periphrasis "які не перебувають у стані простою" and then "активних кубітів" — where one consistent rendering (e.g. "які не простоюють" / "неактивні") would read better. Neither could mislead a learner.

examples.source: you can _measure_ it onto a [classical bit]
examples.suggested: можна _виміряти_ його в [класичний біт]
examples.translation: можна _виміряти_ його на [класичний біт]
examples.why: "на класичний біт" is a direct calque of English "onto"; Ukrainian takes "в/у + accusative" for reading a value into a register — and line 102 of the same file already writes "виміряти всі кубіти у відповідні класичні біти", so the file is inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: To measure all qubits that are not idle, use the `measure_active` method. This method creates a new `ClassicalRegister` with a size equal to the number of non-idle qubits being measured.
examples.suggested: Щоб виміряти всі кубіти, які не простоюють, використовуй метод `measure_active`. Цей метод створює новий `ClassicalRegister` розміром, що дорівнює кількості таких (неідлових/активних) кубітів, які вимірюються.
examples.translation: Щоб виміряти всі кубіти, які не перебувають у стані простою, використовуй метод `measure_active`. Цей метод створює новий `ClassicalRegister` розміром, що дорівнює кількості активних кубітів, які вимірюються.
examples.why: "idle" is rendered twice in adjacent sentences by two different expressions — the bureaucratic periphrasis "не перебувають у стані простою" and then "активних". Both are semantically correct (non-idle = active), so nothing misleads, but a native technical editor would pick one rendering and drop the stiff "у стані простою".

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every claim (30-day trial, billing verification, "not charged" on the free Open Plan, the Create Case / Account verification path, the country-availability caveat) matches the English exactly, and informal "ти" holds throughout. editor_note: Meaning is fully faithful — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat; the compatibility caveat, the pre-processing-overhead trade-off and the "avoid errors before they happen" framing all land correctly, and the informal "ти" register is consistent throughout (Дивись / Дізнайся / Вивчи / Визнач / своє завдання). What a native technical editor would change are three English-syntax calques: "Дивись [Техніки…] для пояснення кожної" and "Дивись [таблицю сумісності функцій] … для повних деталей" both transplant the English "See X for Y" frame, which Ukrainian technical prose renders as "Пояснення кожної з них наведено в…" / "докладніше див…"; and "Ці техніки зазвичай викликають накладні витрати на попередню обробку" uses "викликають" where "призводять до додаткових витрат" is the idiomatic collocation. editor_note: The topic sentence that opens the whole partial-measurement discussion drops its negation: EN "We could, however, choose to measure not *every* system, but instead just some of the systems" became "غير أننا قد نختار قياس *كل* الأنظمة، بل بعضها فقط" — literally "we may choose to measure ALL the systems, rather only some of them", a self-contradictory sentence whose first clause asserts the opposite of the point being introduced (it needs "قد نختار ألّا نقيس *كل* الأنظمة"). Beyond that, "tensor product" is split three ways within the file — the section heading and the whole matrix half use حاصل الضرب التنسوري (l.248, 730–866) while the entire vector half uses الجداء التنسوري (l.261–412) — with "Cartesian product" likewise split between الضرب الديكارتي / حاصل الضرب الديكارتي / الجداء الديكارتي, and "argument" between الوسيط (l.332, 406) and المعامل (l.526). "Uncertainty" is عدم اليقين at l.461–462 but becomes الغموض ("ambiguity") one line later at l.464, and l.683 leaves an untranslated, redundant "بالمقياس modulo $8$". Everything else — the independence proof, the conditional-probability normalization, the controlled-NOT description, the faster-than-light-signaling argument — is faithful, and the informal register (لاحظ، تذكّر، تخيل) holds throughout.

examples.why: The negation "not" is dropped, so the first clause states the opposite of the English and contradicts the trailing "بل بعضها فقط". This is the pivot sentence introducing partial measurement; a learner reads it as "we may choose to measure all the systems".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every claim in the last 40% (gentle-measurement setup Tr(P₀ρ) > 1−ε, the "squaring numbers between 0 and 1 can never make them larger" aside, the Fuchs–van de Graaf region description, and Uhlmann's max-over-purifications statement) and found no inversion, swapped quantity, dropped caveat or hallucination; "fidelity→الإخلاص" and "purification→تنقية" are consistent. What a native editor would fix is wording: "بشكل شكل" ("in the form of a form") for "in the form of a figure" is a duplicated-word blunder; "root-fidelity" is rendered as a reversed genitive "إخلاص الجذر" ("the root's fidelity") instead of "جذر الإخلاص"; "complex conjugation" is "المرافق المركب" in one paragraph but "الاقتران المركب" (coupling/pairing) in another; "product states" becomes "حالتين منتجتين" ("producing/produced states") rather than "حالتين جدائيتين". Also minor: "up to a global phase" is calqued as "حتى الطور الكلي" (reads as "until the global phase"), and "lemma" is collapsed into "مبرهنة" (same word used for Uhlmann's theorem), with "مبرهنة مساعدة" appearing only once. None of these would mislead a learner; they are stylistic/terminological polish.

editor_note: No misleading content: every quantitative claim survives intact (0.74 أنجستروم equilibrium bond length, -1.17 هارتري total energy, 500 optimization steps, resilience=1 → TREX), and the tricky closing inference ("noise present in both cases, but error mitigation only on real hardware" → "الضوضاء كانت موجودة (أو مُحاكاة) في كلتا الحالتين، لكن تخفيف الأخطاء لم يُستخدم إلا في حالة العتاد الحقيقي") is rendered correctly with the exclusive إلا construction. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "variational trials" is rendered "التجارب التباينية" — تباين is variance/contrast; the established Arabic for variational is التغايرية, and since VQE is kept in Latin script the concept survives, but the adjective is off; (2) ansatz is rendered "الدائرة التقريبية" / "دوائر تقريبية (ansaetze)" — "approximate circuit" rather than the trial-circuit sense (الدائرة التجريبية / أنساتز), though it is at least consistent and glossed once in English; (3) "converged to the required tolerance" → "تقاربت … إلى التفاوت المطلوب" — bare التفاوت reads as "disparity", the numerical term needs التفاوت المسموح به / السماحية; (4) "tutorial" is split within the file: "تعليم تقدير طاقة…" for the Heisenberg link vs "الدروس التعليمية" for the tutorials index. Register is correctly informal throughout (تأكّد من تعديل، لا تنسَ أن تخوض، أنت الآن مستعدّ). None of these rise to a FAIL.
